title: objectui-changeset-digest misses a BREAKING annotation whose heading opens with a warning sign, so the console changeset under-counts breaking entries and can skip the ADR-0087 disposition
body:
Filing-gate category ① — a product defect with a named landing point; `reach:` exception **release text** (the digest writes text that publishes into the `@objectstack/console` CHANGELOG).

**Reader who acts:** the `domain:devx` execution seat, and every later console pin hop (each runs `scripts/bump-objectui.sh`, which calls this digest). Found by the os-dev on #23104 (PR #23110), which hand-corrected this hop's changeset; the next hop gets no such correction unless the digest is fixed.

**Dedupe:** semantic issue search on this repo, closed included, words "objectui changeset digest misses BREAKING annotation heading hasBreakingAnnotation console changeset breaking marker" — 25 hits, none covers this shape (nearest: #6099, the original annotation support, closed; #7044, a frontmatter parser miss, closed).

## Defect

`hasBreakingAnnotation()` in `scripts/objectui-changeset-digest.mjs` decides whether an objectui changeset is declared breaking by its body annotation. Its block-opener rule (`BREAKING_BLOCK_OPENER`, a regex on the line start) admits an optional heading mark, an optional bullet and optional emphasis before the word `breaking`, and nothing else. objectui#12242's changeset opens its annotation with a warning sign between the heading mark and the word, so the digest reads it as not breaking.

## Reproduction (objectstack `main` @ `36b2889c`, objectui `1fb1ced36243`)

```js
// node --input-type=module, from the objectstack repo root
import { hasBreakingAnnotation } from './scripts/objectui-changeset-digest.mjs';
// body = git -C ../objectui show 1fb1ced36243:.changeset/12242-types-field-metadata-family.md
hasBreakingAnnotation(body);                                          // false
hasBreakingAnnotation(body.replace('## ⚠️ BREAKING', '## BREAKING'));  // true
```

The heading at line 28 of that changeset reads: `## ⚠️ BREAKING, priced as minor under the fixed group's version policy`.

## Consequence

- Running the bump over `7578323a544e..1fb1ced36243` wrote the objectui#12242 `@object-ui/types` entry unmarked and the count line "1 of these carries a breaking change" (two are declared breaking). That text publishes as written unless someone hand-edits it, as PR #23110 did.
- A range whose ONLY breaking entry uses this heading shape would also produce no breaking count at all, and so skip the ADR-0087 disposition prompt the breaking path raises.

## Fix lands in

`scripts/objectui-changeset-digest.mjs` (`BREAKING_BLOCK_OPENER` / `hasBreakingAnnotation`) plus a `--self-test` case for a heading that carries a leading emoji or symbol before the word. Whether to accept any non-word prefix or an enumerated set is the implementer's call against objectui's actual changeset corpus.
